contracts.text: Function signature: NewMuxSession(conn net.Conn, cfg *MuxConfig) (*MuxSession, error)
MuxSession exposes methods: Close() error and NumStreams() int
DefaultMuxConfig() returns MuxConfig with fields: Side (MuxSide), MaxFrameSize, SendWindow, RecvWindow (bytes)
Constants defined: MuxSideClient and MuxSideServer of type MuxSide; MuxPriorityHigh, MuxPriorityNormal, MuxPriorityLow
OpenStream(priority uint8) (*MuxStream, error) — "either side may call it"
AcceptStream() (*MuxStream, error) — "receives remote streams"
"Client streams use odd IDs (1,3,5,...), server uses even (2,4,6,...)"
"IDs match on both peers" for the same stream
MuxStream has methods: Read, Write, Close, SetReadDeadline(time.Time) error, ID() uint32
"Write blocks until fully accepted (no short writes except on error)"
"SetReadDeadline expiry returns an error satisfying net.Error with Timeout() true"
"Per-stream byte-level send window: writers block when credit is exhausted"
Blocked writers "resume when the receiver drains data and sends a window update"
contracts.adverse_condition: writers blocked on exhausted send window

contracts.text: "A blocked stream must not stall other streams"
contracts.adverse_condition: one stream's send window is exhausted while other streams have data queued

contracts.text: "Higher-priority streams preempt lower-priority queued traffic"
contracts.adverse_condition: lower-priority data queued when higher-priority data arrives

contracts.text: "Control frames (open/close/window-update) should be sent ahead of data frames"
contracts.adverse_condition: control frames and data frames both queued for sending

contracts.text: Six counters added to Snmp: MuxStreamsOpened, MuxStreamsClosed, MuxFramesSent, MuxFramesReceived, MuxBytesSent, MuxBytesReceived
"MuxBytesSent/MuxBytesReceived count data payload bytes only (not control frame overhead)"
"Increment them on DefaultSnmp during mux operations"
Mux counters "Include them in Header(), ToSlice(), Copy(), and Reset()"
"Closed stream … operations return io.ErrClosedPipe"
Closed "session operations return io.ErrClosedPipe"
"Stream Close() is a half-close: the local side stops writing"
After stream Close(), "already-buffered inbound data remains readable until drained"
contracts.adverse_condition: stream locally closed with buffered inbound data not yet drained

contracts.text: "Closing a stream unblocks its blocked writers"
contracts.adverse_condition: writers blocked on exhausted send window when local Close() is called

contracts.text: "receiving a remote close also unblocks local writers with io.ErrClosedPipe"
contracts.adverse_condition: remote close received while local writers are blocked

contracts.text: "Closing a session unblocks all blocked readers and writers with io.ErrClosedPipe"
contracts.adverse_condition: readers or writers blocked when session Close() is called

contracts.text: Close() "must signal shutdown and return promptly -- it must NOT block waiting for background work to finish, even if the underlying connection's Write is externally blocked"
contracts.adverse_condition: background work in progress or underlying connection Write blocked externally

contracts.text: "A stream is removed from the session map only when both sides have closed AND all buffered data is drained"
contracts.adverse_condition: one side has closed but buffered data remains undrained
